assertions.name: q_holonomic_base3_recurrence_absent
assertions.source: exact null space trivial for the 3-adic-principled bases {3, 1/3} (and classical k) through (r≤3,E≤3) ⇒ D(ũ) is not q-holonomic at accessible order in the structurally-indicated base

description: Exact q-holonomic (q-difference) recurrence test for the bar-odd D-ladder d_k=a_k+b_k√3, base fixed by the observed 3-power denominators (v_3(den d_k)~1.5k). Coefficients polynomial in X^k (X=3 principal, 1/3 reciprocal, classical k control), genuine ℚ(√3) coupling, exact rational null space (no floats/PSLQ/fit). A nontrivial kernel = an exact q-difference closed form for D(ũ); empty across bases tightens the resurgent/non-q-holonomic reading. Follows PR #3737 (coupled-recurrence negative) + #3716; sibling #3683 does κ-tower Borel (distinct object). Scope-(a); nothing wired.

data.verdict: NO q-holonomic recurrence in base {3,1/3} (+ classical k) up to (r≤3,E≤3)
